recommendations.description: Require a GA retrospective prior-authorization compliance review for COMMUNITY HOSPITAL Concomitant Left Atrial Appendage Closure and Cardiac Ablation admissions tied to PAROXYSMAL ATRIAL FIBRILLATION and OTHR PERSISTENT ATRIAL FIBRILLATION, and evaluate a non-ER site-of-care opportunity for this case set.
evidence: COMMUNITY HOSPITAL concentrated GA non-ER ablation admissions.
PAROXYSMAL ATRIAL FIBRILLATION ablation cases carried pa_required_code Y.
OTHR PERSISTENT ATRIAL FIBRILLATION ablation cases carried pa_required_code Y.
Concomitant Left Atrial Appendage Closure and Cardiac Ablation is the leading service driver.

recommendations.description: Launch a contractual claims-processing and auth-to-claim reprocessing review for Medicare GRS PPO Local inpatient claims in GA, CA, and CT with pa_required_code Y and either AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION or facility_type Not Mapped; reconcile mismatched authorizations, verify denial enforcement, and correct facility classification for Aftercare with CC/MCC, Kidney and Urinary Tract Infections without MCC, Degenerative Nervous System Disorders without MCC, CALIFORNIA REHABILITATION INSTITUTE, and THE MIRIAM HOSPITAL.
evidence: GA AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION shifts drove about $4.2M.
Aftercare with CC/MCC contributed about $2.3M in GA.
Kidney and Urinary Tract Infections without MCC added about $1.9M.
Not Mapped facility activity added about $1.8M across GA, CA, and CT.
GA Not Mapped growth centered on Degenerative Nervous System Disorders without MCC.

recommendations.description: Launch a GA PPO Local acute hospital policy audit for PA-required inpatient admissions targeting Concomitant Left Atrial Appendage Closure and Cardiac Ablation, Aftercare with CC/MCC, Pulmonary Embolism with MCC or Acute Cor Pulmonale, Kidney and Urinary Tract Infections without MCC, and Degenerative Nervous System Disorders without MCC to verify authorization-to-claim matching, audit CUMG decision-tree approvals and denials with nurse-to-MD referral escalation, review initial and concurrent level-of-care decisions, and confirm claims processed under contractual reimbursement terms.
evidence: GA authorized atrial fibrillation ablation added about $1.6M from 33 more admissions.
GA authorized aftercare acute admissions added about $445K with paid per admit up $6.5K.
GA authorized UTI acute admissions added about $537K and were largely volume-driven.
Pulmonary embolism and neurologic admissions added about $705K from 61 more admissions.
All cited drivers show pa_required_code Y and auth_dimension_present.

recommendations.description: Perform a focused policy, UM, and claims audit for PPO Local Physical Rehab in GA, CA, and OH to verify prior authorization obtained, authorization-to-actual matching, and denial enforcement, and to review initial and concurrent rehab review KPIs, length-of-stay discharge controls, and provider contract and site-of-care performance for GLANCY REHABILITATION CENTER, Aftercare with CC/MCC, Degenerative Nervous System Disorders without MCC, and Other Disorders of Nervous System with CC.
evidence: Physical Rehab spend rose across GA, CA, and OH PPO Local.
GLANCY REHABILITATION CENTER added about $346K from 11 more rehab admissions.
GA Degenerative Nervous System Disorders without MCC added about $882K.
CA Aftercare with CC/MCC added about $658K with higher paid per admit.
OH Aftercare with CC/MCC added about $352K from 16 more admissions.
Major operational cards show pa_required_code equals Y.

recommendations.description: Implement a CA PPO Local acute hospital reimbursement and authorization policy review of prior-authorized Concomitant Left Atrial Appendage Closure and Cardiac Ablation and Kidney and Urinary Tract Infections without MCC claims, with focused outlier-payment review at ST. JOSEPH'S HOSPITAL AND MEDICAL CENTER, to validate authorization-to-claim enforcement and contract-compliant reimbursement.
evidence: CA authorized atrial fibrillation ablation drove most acute hospital spend growth.
Paid per admit increased for Concomitant Left Atrial Appendage Closure and Cardiac Ablation.
Authorized UTI admissions also increased in CA acute hospitals.
ST. JOSEPH'S HOSPITAL AND MEDICAL CENTER included a very small number of high paid cases.
peer_benchmarking: United Health: routine facility charges are generally bundled; no separate DRG-specific reimbursement stated.
Elevance internal: unlisted codes handled case-by-case with documentation when no established code exists.

recommendations.description: Run targeted claim validation and provider reimbursement review for authorized PPO Local ACUTE HOSPITAL admissions in NH, NY, CA, OH, and PA, prioritizing NH and NY Concomitant Left Atrial Appendage Closure and Cardiac Ablation and recurring Pulmonary Embolism with MCC or Acute Cor Pulmonale, Kidney and Urinary Tract Infections without MCC, and Degenerative Nervous System Disorders without MCC, with authorization-to-actual matching, claims adjudication review, and focused contract/site-of-care review for COMMUNITY HOSPITAL, MERRIMACK HEALTH METHUEN HOSPITAL, and EL CENTRO REGIONAL MEDICAL CENTER.
evidence: All core drivers are authorized acute hospital claims with pa_required_code Y.
NH and NY ablation cases added about $898K on 14 admissions.
NY neurologic stays added about $405K with 15 more admissions.
OH pulmonary embolism added about $186K with 17 more admissions.
PA UTI added about $130K with 20 more admissions.
peer_benchmarking: Elevance internal policy recalculates or reduces DRG payment by excluding HCAC charges and days.
Humana applies conditional reimbursement for specific thrombosis-related indications.

recommendations.description: Launch an OH PPO Local ACUTE HOSPITAL reimbursement and payment-integrity review for authorized Concomitant Left Atrial Appendage Closure and Cardiac Ablation and Kidney and Urinary Tract Infections without MCC admissions, and escalate ST. JOSEPH'S HOSPITAL AND MEDICAL CENTER for provider-specific contract remediation, authorization-to-claim validation, and claims-processing review.
evidence: Authorized atrial fibrillation ablation added about $1.1M with paid per admit up.
Authorized UTI admissions added about $453K with paid per admit up.
ST. JOSEPH'S HOSPITAL AND MEDICAL CENTER had two admissions near $98.7K each.
peer_benchmarking: United Health uses broad UB04 facility bundling for routine inpatient, cardiac, and vent/trach components.

recommendations.description: Initiate targeted post-pay medical record and itemized bill review for rare inpatient outlier admissions at ST. JOSEPH'S HOSPITAL AND MEDICAL CENTER, EL CENTRO REGIONAL MEDICAL CENTER, THE MIRIAM HOSPITAL, MERRIMACK HEALTH METHUEN HOSPITAL, and GLANCY REHABILITATION CENTER involving tracheostomy with prolonged ventilation, lung transplant complication or aftercare, sepsis with MCC, pneumonia, and respiratory infection DRGs, and route unsupported principal diagnosis or DRG assignments for payment adjustment.
evidence: ST. JOSEPH'S tracheostomy/lung transplant complication added $151,746 from one admission.
ST. JOSEPH'S lung transplant aftercare added $45,715 from one admission.
EL CENTRO sepsis with MCC added $19,540 from one admission.
Source groups are flagged low_volume_run and small_n_admissions.
peer_benchmarking: Buckeye Health Plan: post-payment inpatient record review can deny or DRG-adjust unsupported sepsis coding.
Centene: pre- or post-pay review can deny or adjust unsupported inpatient sepsis diagnoses.
Molina: claims are subject to pre- and post-payment DRG clinical validation review.
United Health: claim denied when principal diagnosis is invalid for DRG assignment.
